items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I took Buddy Tate and Earl Warren, Dickie Wells and Emmett Berry... to England and play with Humphrey Lyttleton... So I told him yes, I'd love to. So the next year I went over there with my own band... I took... Earl Warren

ctx.x: So, I told him, I said, you know one thing I'm not going to go back in the Apollo Theater. And so he got mad about it, but I didn't go back. I didn't go back and he never did pay me. Not until today he hasn't paid me for that.
What do you mean, oh, you didn't go back to conducting?
